title: Shatterbelt scene state diagram
description: What the Shatterbelt page is doing, as the Scene union in src/main.ts. beginOnline() replaces any scene with an online play scene when the host's start message arrives.

states.description: The title and the table (the public one once loaded, else this browser's) over an attract game; LAUNCHING… while a seed is requested, JOINING THE GAME… while an online game is awaited.
A game, solo or online; a solo game can be paused.
The name form for a pilot whose score makes a table.
Sending the game to the server, or online, waiting for the host's results.
The public table's answer, or why it couldn't be reached.

transitions.trigger: launch(): Space, Enter, fire, or a tap on LAUNCH
transitions.guard: not already launching, and not waiting to join an online game
transitions.action: Ask for a seed; newGame(coop, 1, seed); a Recorder.

transitions.trigger: a pause press, a window blur or a hidden tab
transitions.action: A pause press (P, START, the PAUSE button) toggles paused; Escape, a blur or a hidden tab only pauses.

transitions.trigger: Escape, or Back on a gamepad
message closed, or the games fall out of step
afterGame(), on a key or tap after 1.2 s
transitions.guard: this browser's pilot made the public or the local table
nobody here made a table, and the game was solo or had no seed
online, with a seed, and this browser's pilot made no table
solo with a seed and a name, or online with a seed
transitions.action: submit(), or online, send the name to the others.

transitions.guard: no seed, or solo with no name

transitions.trigger: submitGame() answers, or the host's results arrive
online: nobody gave a name, or the host found none
a key or tap after 0.8 s
